_derivation.note: official_fields.json is produced by build_official_fields.py (committed alongside, deterministic, local-only). There is NO machine-readable TTD field enum and the Partner Portal is a client-side-rendered SPA (WebFetch + r.jina.ai both return empty -- same failure mode as the amazon-ads docs site). The AUTHORITY for field VOCABULARY is the Supermetrics catalog (docs.supermetrics.com/docs/the-trade-desk-fields.md, 275 fields = 164 dimensions + 111 metrics, 22 sections) transcribed VERBATIM into Annex A of _bmad-output/implementation-artifacts/research/thetradedesk-catalog-research.md. A mandatory live probe of the facets endpoint settles divergences.
_derivation.count_divergence: Supermetrics 275 (164 dim + 111 met). 12 fields are Supermetrics connector plumbing (DATASOURCE x3 + QUERY x9, system_metadata.* / dataSourceName) -> excluded: enrichment-only. 14 fields are TTD DEPRECATED (10) + LEGACY (4) still queryable for historical windows -> exposed with a deprecated note. Net TTD-API surface ~263. The provider may be AHEAD of Supermetrics (e.g. 'Selling party name/ID' replacing SupplyVendor) -> probe adds facet-only fields (inverted drift).
_derivation.field_identity: TTD reports are dimensions + metrics selected on a ReportTemplate (analogous to amazon-ads columns on a report type). Ratio/derived metrics (Cpm, Cpc, Ctr, CpaClick, CpaView, CpaTouch, CpaTimeWeightedDecay) are NON-ADDITIVE (AD-4): stored raw per row, recomputed in the semantic layer. PlayerRewind is an ADDITIVE count despite the 'Rewind' name (NOT mis-tagged). Physical types transposed from the Supermetrics data-type column; the live probe / report CSV is authority for coercion. Landing numeric coercion is driven by the catalog physical_type, never by an id suffix.

field_compatibility._note: Core field-compat contract (core/field_compat.py). ONE selectable_set per managed ReportTemplate scoped {"report_template": <id>}; allowed_fields = that template's legal dimension+metric set. Enforcement: connector calls core.field_compat.enforce_selection BEFORE building the reportschedule body -- a column absent from the template facet set never reaches the provider (typed invalid_request with the rule id). GENERATED by build_official_fields.py from REPORT_TEMPLATES. These rules are RECOMMENDED (dossier section 8); the LIVE facet enum is authority and confirms/extends them at probe (DRAFT status).

report_template_compatibility._note: TTD MyReports is NOT create-on-the-fly: a ReportTemplate (dimensions+metrics+filters) must pre-exist (created in the My Reports app UI or cloned from a predefined template). Realistic model = one managed template per report profile. Each entry maps a report profile to its dimensions/metrics; the connector caches the resolved ReportScheduleId per datastream (listing is slow, ~1 min+). columns_ref points at template_columns.json (the generated per-template requestable set feeding the field_compat selectable_set rules).

_freshness_and_lookback.refresh_cadence: aggregated reports batch; third-party integrations refresh 6am CST daily
_freshness_and_lookback.restatement: conversion families (click/view-through/touch/time-weighted-decay, pixels 01-06) restate as attribution windows close; treat last ~3-7 days as provisional
_freshness_and_lookback.attribution_windows: ReportTemplate-configured (set in the My Reports UI), NOT a global API constant -> confirm at probe
_freshness_and_lookback.date_window: set on the ReportSchedule body (rolling window), not an arbitrary API date picker; default backfill observed 1 day
_freshness_and_lookback.recommended_refetch: nightly 3d (attribution provisional tail) + weekly 14d + monthly 45d; AD-7 supersede (QUALIFY on pull_id) makes every re-pull idempotent
_freshness_and_lookback.report_generation: asynchronous: POST reportschedule (referencing a pre-existing ReportTemplate) -> executions on recurrence -> poll reportexecution/query to Complete -> download pre-signed DownloadURL (amazon-ads flow shape)

_auth_and_quota.long_lived_token: alternative to Login/Password: a long-lived token generated once in the partner portal (shown once). Manifest auth path (Nango vs platform api_key) settled at probe.
_auth_and_quota.token_ttl: time-limited (ExpirationDateUtc); exact TTL UNDOCUMENTED (commonly a 90-day sliding window) -> proactive refresh before expiry (connector refreshes when ExpirationDateUtc is passed).
_auth_and_quota.rate_limiting: UNDOCUMENTED per partner/advertiser. 429 -> core.quota.RateLimitError (breaker); no published Retry-After -> default exponential backoff, conservative pacing. Spread report creation through the day; listing reports is slow (~1 min+), cache ReportScheduleId per datastream.
